node.title: Mattarei affine-pair prime-subfield descent
node.statement: If K<=F_p^* and two nonconstant affine forms have coefficients in F_p, their simultaneous K-membership set over any extension F_q already lies in F_p, so the Mattarei prime-field bound applies unchanged. The deployed KoalaBear order-2^21 subgroup passes this descent with index 1016 and 1016^3>4n despite its p^6 ambient field. The Mersenne-31 quartic order-2^21 subgroup does not descend and is explicitly excluded.
